patch_description: Replace the filtering-only Kalman pass with a forward Kalman + Rauch-Tung-Striebel (RTS) backward smoother on the [level, slope] state. Gens 25/32 showed this beats the current best on lag error (0.31 vs 0.35) and noise reduction while matching correlation 0.94; the only weakness was smoothness, caused by aggressive lead/hysteresis add-ons — so we keep the proven Gen 7 post-stages exactly: double zero-phase Savitzky-Golay, a conservative slope-lead compensation (0.25·0.5·sg_half), and end-aligned trimming. We store s[i], P[i], and the predicted s_pred[i], P_pred[i] during the forward loop, then run the standard RTS recursion: s_smooth[i] = s_filt[i] + G[i](s_smooth[i+1] − s_pred[i+1]) with G = P_filt Fᵀ P_pred⁻¹. Q stays at 0.05·(median|diff|)² and the 2-state constant-velocity model is retained, since 3-state variants with reversal gates injected jitter in Gens 25/26/28/32. The robust innovation gating and adaptive R from the current program are preserved. This combines the two proven winners: RTS's lag/noise advantage plus Gen 7's smoothness stages, without the failed extras.
